Twelve years ago, she saved his life.
Marcus Grant ran the Southside with his best friend, Dre.
Get in this car. Or I'm done with you.
Dre did nine years. For both of them.
Marcus gave her everything. Every key. Every password. Every dollar.
But Tasha wanted something of her own.
A card in his name. Thirty one thousand dollars.
A loan on his mother's house. His name. Not his hand.
His birthday. Their anniversary. She was always somewhere else.
One night, he came home early. Her phone went straight to voicemail.
Then, behind the heels he bought her, something was buzzing.
